item.text: {"action":"batch","arguments_json":"{\"calls\":[{\"action\":\"read\",\"arguments\":{\"path\":\"report.json\"}},{\"action\":\"read\",\"arguments\":{\"path\":\"TASK.md\"}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json; from work import evaluate\\nP=json.load(open('policy.json')); R=json.load(open('requests.json')); expected=[evaluate(r,P) for r in R]; actual=json.load(open('report.json')); assert actual==expected\\n# edge, precedence, boundaries, bool rejection, immutability\\ncases=[({'from':'x','to':'y'}, {'edges':{},'retry_limit':2}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'blocked'}), ({'from':'a','to':'b','role':'bad','attempts':99}, {'edges':{'a>b':{'role':'good'}},'retry_limit':2}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'permission'}), ({'from':'a','to':'b','attempts':0}, {'edges':{'a>b':{}},'retry_limit':2}, {'ok':True,'value':'b','reason':'ok'}), ({'from':'a','to':'b','attempts':2}, {'edges':{'a>b':{}},'retry_limit':2}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}), ({'from':'a','to':'b','attempts':True}, {'edges':{'a>b':{}},'retry_limit':2}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'})]\\nfor r,p,w in cases:\\n rb,pb=copy.deepcopy(r),copy.deepcopy(p); assert evaluate(r,p)==w; assert r==rb and p==pb\\nprint('checks passed')\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"git\",\"diff\",\"--\",\"work.py\",\"report.json\"]}},{\"action\":\"memory\",\"arguments\":{\"action\":\"open_questions\"}}]}"}
